articles.title: Suspect arrested, another sought, after vehicles at MPs Scarborough home set on fire

articles.title: Knife-wielding man on Brooklyn Bridge cables fatally shot after ignoring orders to drop weapon
articles.summary: Police fatally shot a knife-wielding man walking on the cables of New York City’s Brooklyn Bridge after he ignored orders to drop the weapon, authorities said Friday. The shooting happened when he moved within feet of an officer trying to help him climb down.

articles.title: Feds open probe into Musk’s steering-wheel-free taxis a day after he began offering rides in them
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Federal regulators are opening an investigation into whether Tesla's new steering-wheel-free taxis comply with safety rules a day after the company began offering rides in the vehicles.

articles.title: Woman suffers ‘life-altering’ injuries after being struck by garbage truck in Fashion District
articles.summary: A woman has suffered “life-altering” injuries after being struck and pinned under a garbage truck in the Fashion District of the city. Investigators say the crash occurred on Adelaide Street West near Brant Street just before 10 a.m. on Friday. Paramedics tell CityNews a 28-year-old woman was pinned under the truck.
